translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Corintios
book.title: Corintogi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Corintios

content: Igi-dibe, sunna dulemar-gaya-baid-baid-sunmakmalad an sunmak-dibe, degine, angermar-gaya an wisbar-dibe, ar degite, sabedgi an imaksulile, an binsa esnon ee oimakeyob, degine, bormo-matargana na abin-abin sarsolenaiyob an gudiido.

Igi, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba an abingasad, an baiganga uk-dibe, degine, bela ibmarmar-dukuar-mamaid an wisbar-dibe, degine, ibmarmar-bela-sunna-wisguleged an wisgunonibar-dibe, degine, bela ulubgi bensulidba sunna yarmar an onnirbar-dibe, ar sabedgi an imaksulile, binsa an gudiido.
Igi, an bela-ibmar-nuegan-an-nikad an bela wileganga uk-dibe, degine, an-san-ogumaklegegala an ukbar-dibe, ar sabedgi an imaksulile, bela we ibmarmar-binsaleddo.
Dulemar-sabguedi weyobid: Na urwed bargaed, nued-binsaedgi dulemar-bendaked, geg nobgued, geg na san dummarba itoged, degine, geg baiganba dummarba na san imaked.
Geg gwinni-gwinni daed, ibmar imakalir, geg eginbi binsaed, geg gwae-gwae urwed, degine, dule egi nosale geg bar ebinsaed, egi nosad nossulidyob dakde-daed.
Dule-baigan-iskuedgi geg wergued, unnila igar-napiragwadginbi wergued.
Dulemar sabguedi bela ibmar-nunmaked-abin burdi-daed, bela ibmar bensur-daed, bela bensulidgi edarbedii-daed, degine, bela ibmar-naibid-abin burdi-daed.

We sabgued-igar geg bergued, degi-sadeguoed. Ibagan-danikoed, yo-ibmar-guoedgi-sunmaked-igardi bergudoed, gaya-baid-baid-sunmaklemalad bar sunmaklegosulid, degine, ibmar-nue-wisi-gumalad bergudmogoed.
Ar emigindi abala ibmar an wismalad, degi, iche-iche yo-ibmar-guoedgi an sunmakmalad.
Ar bela ibmar-napiramalad nonikirdi, we-ibmar-amba-akuarmalad bergudoed.
An bipigwaunni, bipiganayob an sunmaksad, bipiganayob an binsasad, bipiganayob ibmar an daksad. An dule-macheredga an gunonigu, bar mimmiganayob an dae-gussulid.

Emigindi ispe-sunnasulidgi ibmar bole-bole dakeyob Bab-Dummad-ibmar an dakmalad. Ibagan danikoed, anmar na dule nue-asabin na dakeyob Bab-Dummad-ibmar daknonikoed. Emigindi bukidar amba an wichurmalad, igi Bab Dummad an-wisi, yoedsedi deyob an Bab-Dummad-wisgunonimogoed.

Emigindi, Bab-Dummad-bensulid-igar, nue-bensulidgi Bab-Jesúsgi ibmar-nuegan edarbediid-igar, degine, sabgued-igar, wemar-sogbaagwadi, na sadeguoed. Ar degite, wemar-sogbaagwad, sabgued-igar bur emargi obinsiid.
